verdict.rationale: Auth0 Actions (and legacy Rules) let developers write versioned Node.js functions that automatically fire on tenant events such as login, pre-user-registration, and other identity flows, which is exactly the 'define rules that trigger actions on events' capability (auth0-docs-52, auth0-docs-83, auth0-docs-79). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of Actions in practice, a full enumerated list of supported trigger/event types, and explicit tie-in to AI-native workflows (the AI agent docs focus on auth/token delegation rather than the Actions rules engine itself).
